title: The Indus script nobody can read

facts.claim: The Indus (Harappan) civilisation flourished around 2600-1900 BCE in what is now Pakistan and north-west India
Thousands of inscribed seals and objects survive, but the script has never been deciphered
Inscriptions are very short, typically around five signs, with roughly 400 distinct signs
There is no known bilingual text, unlike the Rosetta Stone, which is a major reason it resists decipherment
In January 2025 Tamil Nadu's chief minister announced a US$1 million prize for anyone who deciphers it

opening.why: The seal with its unreadable signs is the hook; the region is well known to Indian viewers.

music_mood: curious and tense: ticking pulse, soft bells on each sign

headline: INDIA'S CODE
NO ONE CAN READ
cover.hook_voiceover_ml: 4,000 വർഷം പഴയ ഒരു ഇന്ത്യൻ ലിപി. ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്ന ഒരാൾക്കും അത് വായിക്കാനാവില്ല!
cover.visual: A small square clay seal fills the frame: a carved unicorn-like bull and a row of strange signs above it, lit from the side.
cover.build_cmd: Dark background with a warm side light. Centre: a square seal (720x720, rounded corners, fill #c9a678 with a darker bevel edge, slight 3° rotation) at x0.5 y0.45. On it: a bull-like animal silhouette (simple body, one long horn, a 'standard' object in front) in dark brown occupying the lower 60%, and above it a row of 6 invented abstract signs (strokes, forks, circles, fish-like shapes: NOT real letters) in dark brown. The signs glow one by one in the accent colour from 20% to 70%, then all pulse together. Slow push-in.

scenes.voiceover_ml: മോഹൻജൊദാരോയും ഹാരപ്പയും. 4,000 വർഷം മുമ്പത്തെ വമ്പൻ നഗരങ്ങൾ.
scenes.headline: CITIES 4,000 YEARS AGO
scenes.visual: A top-down plan of a brick city grows: straight streets, blocks, and a large bath; tiny dots of people move along the streets.
scenes.build_cmd: Sand background (#d8c49a). A city grid draws itself: 6 vertical and 8 horizontal street lines (dark brick colour #7a4a32, 10px) over 0-40%; between them 30 blocks (rects #a86a48) fill in over 20-60%; a large rectangle 'Great Bath' with an inner pool (blue) at x0.42 y0.4 pops at 60%. 40 small dots (people) move along the streets in straight segments. Subtle paper grain overlay.

scenes.voiceover_ml: അവിടെ നിന്ന് ആയിരക്കണക്കിന് മുദ്രകൾ കിട്ടി. എല്ലാത്തിലും ഒരേ തരം അടയാളങ്ങൾ.
scenes.headline: THOUSANDS OF SEALS
scenes.visual: A grid of small seals fills the screen one by one, each with a different animal and a few signs; the camera drifts over them.
scenes.build_cmd: Dark background. A 4x5 grid of seals (each 200x200, sand colour, 2° random tilt) fills the middle band; each seal shows a small animal silhouette (alternate bull, elephant, rhino, tiger as simple shapes) and 3-5 invented signs on top. Seals pop in one by one (scale 0.6 to 1) every 0.12 s from 5%; the whole grid drifts slowly upward (40px) and a soft spotlight (radial light) moves across it.

scenes.voiceover_ml: പക്ഷേ ഓരോ എഴുത്തിലും ശരാശരി അഞ്ച് അടയാളം മാത്രം. പരിഭാഷയുള്ള ഒരു കല്ലും കിട്ടിയിട്ടില്ല.
scenes.headline: NO ROSETTA STONE
scenes.visual: Left: a short row of five signs with a question mark pulse; right: a stone slab with three text bands where two are unreadable and one is blank where a translation should be.
scenes.build_cmd: Left half: a single seal strip with exactly 5 invented signs; a measuring bracket underneath it draws at 15%. Right half: a dark stone slab (rounded rect 380x520) with three horizontal text bands (rows of small marks): the top band in Indus-style signs, the middle band in a different invented script, and the bottom band EMPTY with a dashed outline that pulses in the accent colour from 60%. Gentle alternating light on each half.

scenes.voiceover_ml: ദ്രാവിഡമോ? സംസ്കൃതത്തിന്റെ പൂർവികനോ? AI പോലും തോറ്റു.
scenes.headline: EVERY THEORY FAILED
scenes.visual: Signs float in the air while glowing 'keys' (theory shapes) try to fit a lock and bounce off; a computer screen of scrolling symbols flickers behind.
scenes.build_cmd: Background: a faint grid of scrolling invented signs (0.25 opacity, drifting upward). Centre: a padlock shape (body 260x200 + shackle) at x0.5 y0.46 in dark grey with an accent keyhole. Three keys (simple key shapes, different colours) approach from the left at 15%, 40%, 65%; each slides into the keyhole, shakes twice, and bounces back out (ease), leaving a small 'x' spark. At 85% the keyhole glows with a question-mark-shaped flicker (draw a '?' from strokes). Keep it playful but clean.

scenes.voiceover_ml: 2025-ൽ തമിഴ്നാട് ഒരു മില്യൺ ഡോളർ സമ്മാനം പ്രഖ്യാപിച്ചു. 4,000 വർഷത്തെ ഈ നിശ്ശബ്ദത ആര് പൊളിക്കും?
scenes.headline: $1 MILLION PRIZE
scenes.visual: A spotlight on the seal from the cover; a glowing prize ring and coins orbit it; the signs stay unlit, waiting.
scenes.build_cmd: Reuse the cover seal composition at 0.8 scale. From 15% a golden ring (stroke 14px, radius 420) draws around the seal clockwise over 0.8 s, then 12 small coins (gold discs) orbit the ring slowly. A spotlight cone from top-left brightens the seal over the scene. The signs on the seal stay dark (unread) except a slow 'breathing' outline in the accent colour at the very end (85-100%).

instagram_caption:
A 4,000-year-old Indian script that nobody has ever been able to read. 🔍

The Indus cities of Mohenjo-daro and Harappa left thousands of seals with short inscriptions, about five signs each, and no bilingual text to help. Every theory, from Dravidian to 'not a language at all', has failed. In 2025 Tamil Nadu announced a $1 million prize for anyone who cracks it. 💰

Could it be a language we still speak today? 👀
